text: eToro Group Ltd. is an Israeli-founded, UK-headquartered trading platform that went public on Nasdaq on May 15, 2025, in an upsized IPO of 13,711,470 Class A shares at $52.00 per share, for gross proceeds of $403.0 million.

source.name: eToro Group Ltd. Form 6-K (SEC) - IPO consummation
source.quote: On May 15, 2025, eToro Group Ltd. (the “Company”) consummated its initial public offering (“IPO”) of 13,711,470 shares of Class A Common Shares, no par value
